def _apply_for_each(func, path, val):
    """Apply func to val, or if val is a list (from wildcard expansion), apply recursively to each element."""
    path_items = list(path.items()) if hasattr(path, 'items') else []
    wildcard_count = sum(1 for op, arg in path_items if op == 'P' and arg == '*')
    
    def _apply_recursive(val, depth):
        if depth > 0 and isinstance(val, list):
            for item in val:
                _apply_recursive(item, depth - 1)
        else:
            func(val)
    
    _apply_recursive(val, wildcard_count)
